comment: Dr. Summers is one of the most passionate professors I ever had and I was always intrigued with each lesson. I learned a lot about Africa and colonization, but still, we had to read way too many readings. There is a quiz or paragraph for every single class, but she is very understanding and will meet with you if you have a hard time in class.

DO NOT TAKE EPIDEMICS AND EMPIRES. This class is a serious GPA deflator, she is a hard grader and if you work hard on your paper and go to the writing consultant you will get a B at best. Her criteria for any assessment is disorganized and unclear. Homework every night that is upwards of 80 pages and quizzes almost every class. Readings are BORING
She assigns wayyyy too much reading. a first year seminar is supposed to help you get used to college but this class mightve been my heaviest class...sigh beware if you want to take her class.

Dr. Summers is obsessed with Africa. The course was called Epidemics and Empires but it was all about Africa, which was disappointing. She assigns way too much reading and it's difficult to manage. There are 2 papers, a midterm and a final. She bases the tests off her 300 level history classes which is ridiculous.
The best professor I've taken classes with at UR. Her courses have been challenging, but extremely rewarding. I highly recommend her.

She's a little crazy, but a good teacher, and passionate about Africa.  Her lectures are very clear, and she presents the material in a good way. There's a lot of reading though, and quizzes almost every day. She trips a lot in class too, which makes it entertaining.

I didnt like her at all. You have quizes everyday. Tons of reading (At least 150 pages per class). Her grading is impossible. Its just like you know know what she wants from you. She makes you think what she wants to hear.The discussion are mainly based on her thought and you are supposed to write a paper on that.Don't make a mistake of taking her.
